original_CPU.scope:
Execute unchanged original named-bitmask parser/setter instructions.

comparison or out-of-contract input longer than255pre-NULbytes is claimed.

inactive_build_cache_cleanup.scope: Only inactive dedicated build cache cleaned. All selected historical and current programs,44 products, original C reproductions and compression pilots retain their paths and bytes. Modules, assets,Save, failures and CI ZIPs preserved.

caller_scope: Public constchar** arrays use native pointer stride. The active monster-definition C caller explicitly selects the packed four-byte table/native-sidecar adapter, preserving original uint32 mask then uint16 cast. Original setter uses full32bit index and x86 modulo32 shift; incoming char overflow is not preserved. Parser retains uppercase NULL-prefix behavior, plus-only strtok, empty-token handling, first case-insensitive match, live mask OR, exact declared service order and void return. Foreign scratch and locked OS thread preserve libc strtok lifetime/TLS. Three declared ASCII libc boundaries limit original-reference coverage; no full NLS or out-of-contract >255preNUL input claim. Existing public SaveLoad pixel golden is not promoted.
cleanup_scope: Four already-Go public entries now export directly with original public ABI; const-char typedefs preserve const signatures. Four forwarding C files and two symbol-free empty translation units, plus one obsolete private header, were retired with exact incoming bytes retained. No additional business-port credit.
